[COLORFUL_STAR_SHAPE_LOGO] ATS Ref No. ATS/OL/74 20-Mar-2025 OFFER LETTER Name – Jonny Doe Address – C/O Sample Relative, H.No-000, Example Colony, Sample Nagar, Jalandhar, Punjab-000000 Dear Jonny, Congratulations!! Aerial Telecom Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is pleased to bring you on board. We are pleased to appoint you as **Technical Manager** in our Organization. This offer cum appointment is subject to: - The information provided by you in your Biodata and interviews being correct and valid. - You are found medically fit as per company norms. - No involvement in any illegal activities. - Submission of documents as per Annexure II Your current place of posting will be Jalandhar. Your Date of Joining will be 07-Apr-2025. The terms and conditions of your employment will be as under: **Emoluments/ Remuneration:** Your compensation on a cost to company basis will be **Rs. 565008/- (Rupees Five Lakh Sixty Five Thousand Eight Only/-)** per annum. **Secrecy:** You shall not, either during or after your employment with us, either by word of mouth or otherwise, divulge particulars or details of our processes, technical know-how, security arrangements, administrative and/or organizational matters of confidential or secret nature which it may be your personal privilege to know by virtue of your employment with us and you shall both during and after your employment take all reasonable precautions to keep all such information secret. AERIAL TELECOM SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Address E93, Industrial Area, Phase-VIII, Mohali, Punjab-160071 Contact Number: 0172 - 4001361 Website www.aerialtelecom.in CIN Number U74900PB2010PTC047536 [LOGO_SHAPE] ATS **Misconduct:** a) If at any time in our opinion which is final in this matter, you are involved or found guilty of dis honesty, disobedience, disorderly behavior, negligence or indiscipline or of any other conduct considered by us as detrimental to our interests, or of violation of one or more terms of this letter, your services are liable to be terminated without notice on such disciplinary action as we may deem fit. b) “Any inappropriate communication to our client will be treated as a breach of code of conduct of the company and will make the employee liable for punitive / legal action apart from termination of services”. c) “Any indiscipline which leads to maligning of our company image or our Client’s image will be treated under Code of Conduct of the company & stringent action including but not limited to termination of services will be taken by the Organization”. **Probation:** - You will be on probation period for Six months starting from your date of joining. - After successful completion of probation period, you will be confirmed employee which will be intimated to you by HR. Even if no intimation is received from HR, it will be deemed as confirmed after 6 months of probation period. - If your performance is not in line with your KRAs, your probationary period can be extended. - During the probation period, basis your performance, company may end the services by serving 15 days' Notice or payment in lieu of Notice Period. - You may also leave the organization during your probation period by serving one month Notice. Any misconduct or warning issued to you on disciplinary grounds or non compliance to COC guidelines during your probation period, will lead to revoking/cancellation of your appointment. **Transfer:** Your services are liable to be transferred to any existing or future department, office or establishment forming a part of our organization or to any of our associates, sister, or group concern in India and abroad. On such transfers, you have no right to ask for revision in your salary or any other terms and conditions of your service. In such cases, you will be governed by rules and regulations applicable in the new assignment. **Retirement:** You will retire from the services of the Company on completion of Fifty-eight years of age. The actual date of retirement shallbe the last working day of the calendar month in which your 58th birthday falls. **Duties and Responsibilities:** a) You will perform, observe, and conform to such duties, directions and Instructions assigned or communicated to youby the management and those in authority over you. b) Company personnel are whole time employees and may not undertake any other business, work or public office, honorary or remuneratory, except with the written permission of the management in each case. AERIAL TELECOM SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Address E93, Industrial Area, Phase-VIII, Mohali, Punjab-160071 Contact Number 0172 - 4001361 Website www.aerialtelecom.in CIN Number U74900PB2010PTC047536 [SIX_PETAL_FLOWER_SYMBOL] ATS c) You will not enter into any commitments or dealings on behalf of the Management for which you have no express authority, nor alter or be a party to any alteration of any principle or policy of the management or exceed the authority or discretion vested in you without the previous sanction of the company or those in authority over you. d) You will be responsible for the safekeeping and return in good condition and order of all company's property, which may be in your use, custody, or change. **Termination of Service:** a) The management may terminate your appointment by giving a 60 days' notice or payment in lieu thereof. b) In case an employee decides to leave the services of the company, he/she will be required to serve 60 days' notice. c) In case proper notice is not served as per company policy, then employee will not be issued experience certificate ,relieving letter, salary & other expenses will be put on hold. d) The F&F settlement will be done within 60 days from the date of relieving from the services & with submission of no dues certificate. (This is applicable only in cases where proper notice period has been served.) e) In case of any dispute arising due to the above-mentioned clause you are incumbent to approach the Human Resource Department of Aerial Telecom Solutions for clarification and redressal. f) Aerial Telecom Solutions Pvt. Ltd. in its sole discretion can decide to waive off/ reduce the notice period depending upon the requirement of that profile & exigencies. - In case of absence for a continuous period of 8 days (including absence when leave though applied for is not granted or when you overstay period of sanctioned leave by 8 days), You would lose your lien on the post and the same shall automatically come to an end without any notice. - If at any time in our opinion which is final in this matter, you are involved or found guilty of dis honesty, disobedience, disorderly behavior, negligence or indiscipline or of any other conduct considered by us as detrimental to our interests, or of violation of one or more terms of this letter, your services are liable to be terminated without notice on such disciplinary action as we may deem fit. - Any indiscipline which leads to maligning of our company image or our Client's image and/or leakage/pilferage of company information will be treated under Code of Conduct of the company & stringent action including but not limited to termination of services will be taken by the Organization without any notice **Theft Clause** We may terminate your employment without notice if we have reasonable grounds to suspect that you have engaged in serious misconduct and includes: Theft, Dishonesty or fraud. If anybody found guilty, immediate action up to and including termination of employment followed by legal action will be taken. AERIAL TELECOM SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED Address E93, Industrial Area, Phase-VIII, Mohali, Punjab-160071 Contact Number 0172 - 4001361 Website www.aerialtelecom.in CIN Number U74900PB2010PTC047536 [COLORFUL_STAR_SHAPE_LOGO] ATS **Dispute Resolution** Any disputes/ differences arising during the course of your employment with the company would be referred to the Sole Arbitration of the Director or Manager ATS, who would act as an arbitrator, or appoint any of his nominees for the purpose. It is clearly understood that no party (employee & employer) will have any objection to the appointment of any of the above-mentioned person as an arbitrator. The arbitration shall take place in Mohali /Chandigarh in accordance with the provision of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 as amended up to date. The award of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on both the parties. Kindly return the duplicate copy of this letter, duly signed, in token of your acceptance of the terms and Conditions stipulated herein. Sincerely yours, For and on behalf of Aerial Telecom Solutions Private Limited. **Authorized Signatory** I have gone through the aforesaid terms and conditions/terms of appointment and have fully understood the same. I herebyaccept the above appointment on the terms and conditions stated herein above.
